user.title: New SB Watch rule
user.description: A rule watches what an SB filter matches. Across fields: AND. Within a field: OR. Nothing configured matches nothing.

data.name: Rule name
data.problem: Report as a problem (binary sensor device class)
data.filter_yaml: Advanced: filter as YAML (overrides the fields above)

data_description.patterns: Words in one pattern AND; patterns OR. * and ? wildcards.
data_description.state_for: Time in the current state, from last_changed; bare number = minutes.
data_description.for: An entity counts only after matching this long — hysteresis for flapping values.
data_description.filter_yaml: Paste an SB Entity Browser card's filter keys: patterns, labels, areas, device_classes, units, states, state_min, state_max, state_for.

error.empty_filter: The filter matches nothing — configure at least one field.
error.bad_yaml: The YAML is not a mapping (or does not parse).
error.bad_duration: Unreadable duration — use 2h, 1h30m, 90s, <5m or a number of minutes.
